brief: The application model of a solution: named datasets, the role each part plays over them, and device models, all held as data.
detail: A solution holds datasets (a menu, an order history) and gives each part a role over them: menu, dashboard, api or device. One model drives both the emulator, where each part renders its own app, and the real deployed app. The dashboard figures are genuine computations: orders joined with the menu prices and aggregated by the engine. Names of datasets and parts are stored in lower case. The Q forms (AddDatasetQ, SetPartRoleQ and so on) return the model so that calls chain; the plain forms return nothing. Attach a model to a delivery with SetAppTopology.
receiver:
o1 = new stzAppTopology("bistro")
o1.AddDataset("menu", [ [ "Couscous", "semolina", 12 ], [ "Tea", "mint", 3 ] ])
o1.AddDataset("orders", [ [ "Couscous", 2 ], [ "Tea", 4 ] ])
o1.SetPartRole("admin", "dashboard", "orders")
